note: Both sets contain significant noise, including vague entities ('axis telescope', 'n-axis telescope') and a shared error misbinding the 10 m value as 'size' instead of 'focal length' for the Lynx mirror assembly. Set B is preferred because it correctly extracts the Lynx science instrument count (3), which Set A omits, and it contains fewer instances of the misbound focal length claim (one in B vs two in A).
